tma_bulk_completed_transport_v1.counting_rule: Count transported Q once, never Q read plus Q write across both memory spaces, and never multiply by128 consumer threads. Read/write payload fields refer only to the global-memory side.
tma_bulk_completed_transport_v1.not_claimed: physical HBM bytes, HBM peak, isolated engine throughput or tensor-map throughput

global_layout.allocation_bytes: uint64(blocks)*32*payload_bytes per active global array, plus16-byte guards around whole allocation
global_layout.ownership: disjoint32-slot segment per CTA; GMEM->SMEM input immutable; SMEM->GMEM no other CTA writes this segment
global_layout.address_reuse: exact32-slot ring; full completion before issuing next request; same destination slot is never reused while previous write pending
global_layout.working_set_claim: record actual footprint and L2 bytes; no guaranteed cold/HBM-resident or cache-hit claim
global_layout.allocation_check: all multiply/add/address-range checks in uint64 or size_t before allocation; actual cudaMemGetInfo and shared opt-in capacity/occupancy check before launch

input.arithmetic: unsigned modulo2^32 only for word values/checksum; all indices, word counts, completion counts, byte totals and ns/cycle values are uint64
input.formal_source: GMEM immutable input or prefilled shared tile unchanged across measured iterations
input.destination_initialization: poison every destination word before launch; preserve16-byte guards; correctness compares every word not checksum alone

gmem_to_smem: thread0 initializes8-byte-aligned local mbarrier expected arrivals=1, not128 and notQ; publish initialization with fence.proxy.async.shared::cta and CTA barrier before timing
each iteration thread0 executes mbarrier.expect_tx.relaxed.cta.shared::cta.b64 [bar], Q before launching exactly one bulk copy

issue cp.async.bulk.shared::cta.global.mbarrier::complete_tx::bytes then mbarrier.arrive.release.cta.shared::cta.b64 to capture opaque64-bit phase token; one thread arrival and Q completion bytes must both finish
thread0 polls mbarrier.try_wait.acquire.cta.shared::cta.b64 with that token and bounded globaltimer timeout; completion is never inferred from issuance or plain CTA barrier
after successful wait all128 threads pass CTA barrier, transferring completion to consumers; no shared overwrite/reuse before this gate
reuse same mbarrier for next completed phase without reinitialization; invalidate only after final completion and CTA rendezvous, outside timing
smem_to_gmem: all128 producers fill their shared words before timing; each producer executes fence.proxy.async.shared::cta then CTA barrier before thread0 uses async proxy
thread0 issues exactly one cp.async.bulk.global.shared::cta.bulk_group then cp.async.bulk.commit_group
same issuing thread executes cp.async.bulk.wait_group 0; completion includes destination writes visible to the issuer; follow with CTA barrier before generic consumers or source/destination reuse
formal loop uses full wait0, not read.wait0; only one request/group can remain outstanding and all complete before timer stop
CUDA completion/event/host transfer follows kernel; never interpret issuer-local visibility as unsynchronized cross-CTA or system-wide visibility

source_release_diagnostic.purpose: separate single-request diagnostic before warmup for each SMEM->GMEM coordinate, not formal throughput sample
sequence: same issuer thread0 reads start clock64, issues one request, commits group
thread0 wait_group.read0 then reads source_release clock64
allCTA barrier broadcasts source reuse permission; all producers overwrite every source word with bitwise complement
allCTA barrier; thread0 wait_group0 then reads full_completion clock64; allCTA barrier before output validation
host validates every original destination word unchanged despite source overwrite; retain full output and allthree same-CTA timestamps
source_release_diagnostic.full_endpoint_includes: source-overwrite and diagnostic CTA barriers, so not comparable to formal wait0 service; no subtraction yields pure write tail
source_release_diagnostic.all_gpu: retain perCTA local deltas separately; do not subtract clock64 between CTAs or export aggregate release bandwidth
source_release_diagnostic.claim: wait.read proves source reusable only; it does not establish destination completion, numeric output, or a guaranteed gap before full wait

profile.seed_location: existing top-level invocation and validation row; launch_fields unchanged

failure_policy.wait_bulk_timeout: wait_group has no software-poll timeout; controlled host process timeout/TERM/KILL with confirmed cleanup is mandatory
failure_policy.mbarrier_timeout_action: record failure evidence and fail kernel/process; never normally return/reuse/invalidate a possibly pending barrier or shared destination; a fatal trap is an allowed implementation path only with verified controlled cleanup
failure_policy.classification: timeout/incomplete copy/unknown CUDA failure is failed correctness, never unsupported or accepted sample

shared_layout.opt_in: 64KiB payload exceeds default per-block dynamic threshold: set cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize on actual specialization; include static+dynamic bytes in occupancy/capacity checks; reject unsupported before launch

correctness.whole_family_order: CPU references and representative target compile/SASS -> all24 coordinates short GPU validation -> calibration pilots -> warmup -> formal ten-process sampling; do not warmup/calibrate first case before remaining short profiles pass
correctness.short_rule: same primitive, actual threads/grid/Q/stage layout; inspect every copied word after every request before reuse, independently derive expected from seed/CTA/slot/word; the33-iteration profile covers32-slot wrap and remains within early_validation_v1 maximum64; three paired profiles together launch exactly3 targets percase, without warmup
correctness.formal_gmem_to_smem: after final timed completion, copy allQ/4 shared words perCTA to separate output and compare with final slot=((iterations-1)%32); count every completed request and record wait attempts
correctness.formal_smem_to_gmem: after kernel completion read back and compare every word in all32 slots perCTA; formal min_iterations128 ensures every slot touched; check guards
correctness.source_release: SMEM->GMEM only: separate bulk_source_release_one_request_v1 profile, own process and receipt, one request/one target, top-level seed3; not implicitly included in any of the three short profiles or24 formal throughput cases; each CTA owns its destination, all original words checked after source overwrite and full completion
correctness.checks: all output words plus guard words; raw all-word values or full output artifacts with hashes, never just errors=0 or sampled checksum
negative_tests: Q counted twice or multiplied bythreads
wrong expected bytes or arrival count rejected onCPU beforeGPU
misaligned base, wrong size or overlapping ranges rejected beforeGPU
wrong source slot or uint32 address truncation
single-word corruption including final word of64KiB
read.wait substituted for full destination completion
full-family ordering violation and resume with changed validation identity
correctness.pilot_destination_coverage: pilot32 visits all32 slots0..31 exactly once perCTA; verify every destination word and guards; short1/2 visit only their requested slots and all other slots remain poison; short33 revisits slot0 after one full ring
correctness.short_profile_execution: Exactly these three paired runs per formal case, one separate process and one target launch each; no Cartesian product. seed is the existing top-level invocation/validation seed, never an added launch-record field. Each profile has a single iterations/input-profile pair.
correctness.short_completion_gate: All three exact profile/seed receipts and complete per-request word outputs must pass for each of24 formal cases before that case is short-complete; the entire24-case set must pass before any new pilot or warmup. No profile may replace another or authorize partial-family advancement.

calibration.hook: future explicit adapter.resolve_iterations; no formula eval
calibration.artifact: resolved_cases.json with pilot raw/receipt hashes and source/binary/contract/device identity; freeze percase before formal run
calibration.formal_reuse: all ten processes, retries and resumes use identical resolved length; changing length creates new run
calibration.status: adapter and calibration integration not implemented or approved

raw_extensions.type_rules: JSON integers for byte/count/address-offset fields; size operand uint32 Q<=65536, shared address uint32 after cvta, global pointers64-bit, mbarrier state uint64; require zero local spills
raw_extensions.output_artifacts: full perword output arrays for short/diagnostic and final formal destination coverage; hashes and checked word counts independently verified
raw_extensions.source_release_binding: null only forGMEM->SMEM; otherwise separate launch receipt, seed, original-output artifact, sameCTA timestamp triplets and no metric export

sass_contracts.feasibility: compile-only source checks two bulk directions, expect_tx/arrive/token wait, async proxy fence, bulk commit, wait.read0 and full wait0 onCUDA12.9 sm90a; no hardcoded undocumented SASS mnemonic
sass_contracts.formal: each actual direction/payload specialization must retain one request in measured loop, correct operand widths/addresses/Q, matched expectQ and one arrive or one commit/fullwait, CTA gates, no spill; inspect measured backedge and timing position
sass_contracts.timer_rule: two outer measurement endpoints; internal timeout globaltimer reads are not performance samples and must not be rejected merely for exceeding two static timer sites
sass_contracts.diagnostic: actual separate release/full-wait kernel audited independently; ensure source overwrite occurs after read endpoint and output consumed only after full endpoint
sass_contracts.fail_closed: actual source/PTX/SASS/binary binding and independentB required; compiler acceptance alone grants no GPU runtime or parameter qualification

timing.start: operand/input/shared producer preparation and mbarrier init before timing; thread0 reads globaltimer then clock64; CTA gate after start before first request
timing.loop: oneQ copy per iteration, complete target-specific wait and CTA gate each iteration; no per-request timestamp array, no perword consumer in formal loop
timing.stop: final request fully complete and CTA gate passed; thread0 reads clock64 then globaltimer; output readback, validation and mbarrier invalidation after stop
timing.all_gpu: maxCTA stop_ns-minCTA start_ns; CUDA event is auxiliary enclosure check
timing.timeout_reads: mbarrier internal globaltimer reads belong to service overhead, never extra performance samples
timing.metric_boundary: completed transfer plus issue/wait/CTA control service; no intrinsic bulk-engine latency/peak claim
